snippet.title: The Backrooms Lost to the Dark - Teaser
snippet.description:
We are excited to show you a glimpse of what we are working on. Stay tuned, and for more info join our discord server!

The Backrooms: Lost to the Dark is a asymmetrical horror multiplayer game where one player becomes the Monster, while the others take on the role of the Explorers who work together to try to survive and escape the Backrooms.
